item.tib: mi kha dgra brub dgra zlog me dpung 'bar bsad
item.coloph: ces khro rgyal lha rgod kyi sgo nas mi kha dgra brub dgra zlog 'di ni/ bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung 'khrul med gnam bon shes rab dgongs rgyal gyis sman ri'i bla brang du gu ger bkod pa sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
